system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: For each component, we removed the corresponding section in the main prompt.
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt has sections (SAM, experience rules, few-shot examples) filled per step; mechanism inferred from prose.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The process begins with Content Extractor 1 , which operates on the current webpage statest to capture the content ˆst and enumerate feasible actionsA(ot).
env_context_strategy.note: Harness injects extracted page content and feasible element list each step; the agent navigates the web app by acting. Closest fit to mixed; web domain rather than repo.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: andk is the memory window size
context_compaction.note: Content Extractor reduces HTML to content/actionable elements; memory window k configurable (full memory used by default per ablation). Closest value; truncate_oldest reachable via k.

observation_format.evidence_quote: whereotxt t contains textual DOM information,oimg t is a webpage screenshot, andoelm t denotes the set of interactable elements.
observation_format.note: Screenshot used only when duplicate/ambiguous actions (Alg. 1 line 21-22).

tool_call_format.note: Actions are (op, element, value) tuples selected by LLM; output syntax not described.

tool_count.note: Operations such as click and input; no tool list given.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: whereop denotes an operation (e.g., click or input),
edit_primitive.note: Web testing agent; action space is web element operations, no file editing.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Inspired by ReAct (Yao et al., 2023), which enables LLMs to interleave rea- soning and acting by pausing after each decision to observe the environment, we adopt an iterative action grounding scheme
loop_primitives.note: Per-step State Evaluator decides success/stop before grounding next action.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: HxAgent performs proactive correc- tion which reassesses and adjusts its plan after each step
planning_granularity.note: No stored plan object described; 'plan' is re-derived each step.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: HxAgent oper- ates with two key components: 1) Iterative LLM- based Agent Planning to produce action sequences, and 2) Experience Reinforcement
multi_agent_topology.note: Multiple LLM-prompted components (evaluator, grounding, rule extractor) within one agent loop.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: HxAgent oper- ates with two key components: 1) Iterative LLM- based Agent Planning to produce action sequences, and 2) Experience Reinforcement

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: the outcomey(i) of the ex- perience memoryE is updated automatically when human judgment is not involved in determining task success.
human_in_loop.note: Human judgment of success optionally mentioned but no gating mechanism described.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: HxAgent maintains a structured memory of prior interactions
short_term_state.note: Sequence action memory of (state, action) pairs.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Rules are stored as plain-text heuristics alongside their source SoA.
long_term_memory.note: Long-term experience memory of past trajectories with success labels plus extracted textual rules; closest values.

self_verification.evidence_quote: State Eval- uator 2 implements the evaluation functionG by employing the LLM to evaluate the current state of the action sequence
self_verification.note: Same LLM evaluates state each step; could be seen as llm_judge (separate call).

retry_policy.evidence_quote: This mem- ory stores historical interaction trajectories from multiple tries for each task
retry_policy.note: Multiple tries occur in training phase to build experience; evaluation is single attempt.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: determines whether to stop ex- ecution early due to significant divergence from the expected state, (iv) decides whether the task is complete
termination_condition.note: Alg. 1 'whilet<MAX t do' step cap; early stop by LLM evaluator on divergence coded as stall_detection (closest).

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: We set up Selenium test environ- ment via ChromeDriver.
execution_isolation.note: Selenium/ChromeDriver browser; isolation boundary not stated.

permission_model.evidence_quote: It restricts actions to feasible, executable elements
permission_model.note: Actions constrained to enumerated feasible action set; closest value.

replayability.evidence_quote: The test cases can be automatically replayed in the target environment during regression testing.
replayability.note: Generated SoAs converted to replayable test scripts; environment may differ.
